payload.reason: The evidence indicates that manual annotations were performed on a dataset of named entities, but it does not specify the use of a crowdsourcing platform for these annotations.

claims.text: Manual annotations were performed on a dataset of named entities comprising 53453 tokens and 2566 sentences.
The dataset was created from over 250 news texts and provides annotations for named entity classes: people, organizations, and locations.
The manual annotation relied on categories and guidelines from BBN Technologies, indicating a structured approach to the annotation process.
